mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM career ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.category, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at, cp.id AS profile_id, cp.intro, cp.work_content, cp.requirement, cp.common_tech, cp.suitable_major, cp.development_path, cp.source FROM career c LEFT JOIN career_profile cp ON cp.career_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, c.description AS course_description, cc.course_role, cc.related_ability, cc.related_points, cc.importance, cc.is_core, cc.learning_stage FROM career_course cc JOIN course c ON cc.course_id = c.id WHERE cc.career_id = #{careerId} ORDER BY cc.is_core DESC, cc.learning_stage, cc.id

SELECT c.id AS career_id, c.name AS career_name, c.category, cc.course_role, cc.related_ability, cc.related_points, cc.importance, cc.is_core, cc.learning_stage FROM career_course cc JOIN career c ON cc.career_id = c.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cc.is_core DESC, cc.learning_stage, cc.id
SELECT id, career_id, name, description, ability_type, importance, learning_advice FROM career_ability WHERE career_id = #{careerId} ORDER BY id

SELECT ckp.id, ckp.career_id, ckp.course_id, c.name AS course_name, ckp.knowledge_point_id, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name, kp.description AS knowledge_point_description, ckp.use_scene, ckp.importance, ckp.learning_advice, ckp.source FROM career_knowledge_point ckp JOIN knowledge_point kp ON ckp.knowledge_point_id = kp.id JOIN course c ON ckp.course_id = c.id WHERE ckp.career_id = #{careerId} ORDER BY ckp.importance DESC, ckp.id
